name: @mesh/recorder-interface
description: Standard screen-recording status and control contract.

state.name: available
state.description: Whether a recorder can be started

state.name: recording
state.description: Whether a recording is in progress

state.description: Unix time in seconds the current recording began; 0 when idle

state.description: Path of the current or last recording
